senses.gloss: m. (סָפַד) funeral ceremonies, manifestations of mourning, funeral address, eulogy &c.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 3:8">M. Kat. III, 8</cite> <he>שלא להרגיל את הה׳</he> in order not to invite lamentation.
Tosef. ib. II, 17 ה׳ על לב hesped means beating on the heart.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 3:2:3">Y. Ber. III, 6ᵇ</cite> top [read:] <he>הסופד וכל העסוקין בה׳</he> (v.
<cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 2:11">Tosef. ib. II, 11</cite> ed. Zuck., Var.) the leader of the lamentation and all those engaged in it.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 5:2:3">Y. Succ. V, 55ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>הֶסְפֵּידוֹ של וכ׳</he> the mourning for &c.
Sabb. 153ᵃ מהספדו של אדם וכ׳ from the way a person is mourned for you can learn whether he deserves future happiness; a. fr.—קשר ה׳ to compose and arrange a funeral song.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 16:4:2">Y. Yeb. XVI, 15ᵈ</cite> top <he>מצא ה׳ קשור וכ׳</he> found that lamentations were prepared in his house.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 1:1:8">Y. Yoma I, 38ᵇ</cite>; Y. Sot. I, end, 17ᵈ. Lam. R. introd. (R. Joh. 1).
